subject: Deku Scrub Leader
text: Wearing the Mask of Truth on the platform in the Forest Stage prompts the Deku Scrub leader to give Link the second Deku Nut upgrade, which becomes unobtainable after travelling to adulthood.

evidence.quote: The second Deku Nut Upgrade is can be gotten in the Forest Stage, but requires the Mask of Truth....Drop down into the Forest Stage, equip the Mask of Truth, and stand on the platform before the Deku Scrubs.  The Scrubs will stare at you.  Run over and speak with their leader (the tall one with the mustache), and he'll give you the Deku Nut upgrade....This upgrade is unobtainable if you travel to Adulthood before getting it.

subject: Child's Wallet
text: The Child's Wallet is the default wallet that Link begins the game with, and it can hold 99 rupees.

evidence.quote: This is the default wallet that you begin the game with.  It can hold only 99 rupees.

subject: House of Skulltula
text: The Adult's Wallet holds 200 rupees and is rewarded by the House of Skulltula after killing 10 Gold Skulltulas and collecting their tokens.

evidence.quote: It is a reward from the House of Skulltula, and is obtained after you have killed 10 Gold Skulltulas and taken their tokens.  The Adult's Wallet holds 200 rupees.

subject: House of Skulltula
text: The Giant's Wallet holds 500 rupees and is awarded by the House of Skulltula after collecting 30 Gold Skulltula tokens.

evidence.quote: The largest wallet in the game is also obtained from the House of Skulltula.  After you have killed 30 Gold Skulltulas, return to the House and get the reward.  The Giant's Wallet holds 500 rupees.

subject: Gerudo Fortress
text: The Gerudo's Card is obtained after freeing the four carpenters from Gerudo Fortress.

evidence.quote: The membership card for the Gerudo Thieves, the Gerudo's Card is obtained after you free the four carpenters from the Fortress (which can be done as early as when you first get the Hookshot, though it's easier with the Bow).

subject: Gerudo's Card
text: The Gerudo's Card prevents Gerudo Guards from throwing Link in jail and provides access to the Haunted Wasteland, Gerudo Training Ground, and Horseback Archery Range.

evidence.quote: The Gerudo's Card stops the Gerudo Guards from throwing you in jail, and also lets you access the Haunted Wasteland, the Gerudo Training Ground and the Horseback Archery Range.

subject: Kokiri Emerald
text: The Kokiri Emerald is the first of three Spiritual Stones and is given as a gift from the Great Deku Tree.

evidence.quote: The first of three Spiritual Stones, the Kokiri Emerald is a gift from the Great Deku Tree.

subject: Goron Ruby
text: The Goron Ruby is the second of three Spiritual Stones and symbolizes the pact of brotherhood between Link and the Gorons.

evidence.quote: The second of the three Spiritual Stones, the Goron Ruby is a symbol of the pact of brotherhood that Link shares with the Gorons.

subject: Zora Sapphire
text: The Zora Sapphire is the last of three Spiritual Stones and symbolizes the engagement between Link and Princess Ruto.

evidence.quote: The last of the three Spiritual Stones, the Zora Sapphire is a symbol of the engagement between Link and Ruto.

subject: Light Medallion
text: Rauru gives Link the Light Medallion in the Chamber of the Sages immediately after Link draws the Master Sword from its pedestal.

evidence.quote: A gift from Rauru, the Sage of Light, the Light Medallion is the symbol of Rauru's power.  You obtain it in the Chamber of the Sages, immediately after taking the Master Sword from it's pedestal.

subject: Forest Medallion
text: Saria bestows the Forest Medallion in the Chamber of the Sages after completing the Forest Temple.

evidence.quote: A gift from Saria, the Sage of Forest, the Forest Medallion is the symbol of Saria's power.  You obtain it in the Chamber of the Sages after finishing the Forest Temple.

subject: Fire Medallion
text: Darunia grants the Fire Medallion in the Chamber of the Sages after finishing the Fire Temple.

evidence.quote: A gift from Darunia, the Sage of Fire, the Fire Medallion is the symbol of Darunia's power.  You obtain it in the Chamber of the Sages after finishing the Fire Temple.

subject: Water Medallion
text: Ruto gives the Water Medallion in the Chamber of the Sages upon clearing the Water Temple.

evidence.quote: A gift from Ruto, the Sage of Water, the Water Medallion is the symbol of Ruto's power.  You obtain it in the Chamber of the Sages after finishing the Water Temple.

subject: Shadow Temple
text: Obtaining the Forest Medallion, Fire Medallion, and Water Medallion grants access to the Shadow Temple.

evidence.quote: Once the Forest Medallion, Fire Medallion and Water Medallion are obtained, then you can gain access to the Shadow Temple.

subject: Shadow Medallion
text: Impa grants the Shadow Medallion, the symbol of her power, upon finishing the Shadow Temple.

evidence.quote: A gift from Impa, the Sage of Shadow, the Shadow Medallion is the symbol of Impa's power.

subject: Spirit Medallion
text: Nabooru grants the Spirit Medallion, the symbol of her power, after finishing the Spirit Temple.

evidence.quote: A gift from Nabooru, the Sage of Spirit, the Spirit Medallion is the symbol of Nabooru's power.

subject: Ganon's Castle
text: Obtaining both the Shadow and Spirit Medallions creates the road to Ganon's Castle.

evidence.quote: Once you have obtained both the Shadow and Spirit Medallions, then the road to Ganon's Castle will be created.

subject: Skullkid twins
text: Completing three rounds of the Ocarina memory game with the twin Skullkids as Young Link awards a Piece of Heart.

evidence.quote: Stand on the tree trunk in front of the twin Skullkids and pull out your Ocarina.  The Skullkids will play a memory-style game with you.  Complete three rounds to earn the Piece of Heart.

subject: Lone Skullkid
text: Playing Saria's Song on the tree trunk for the lone Skullkid in southwest Lost Woods as Young Link earns a Piece of Heart.

evidence.quote: Stand on the tree trunk in front of the lone Skullkid, and play him Saria's Song.  He'll give you a Piece of Heart.

subject: Business Scrub
text: A Business Scrub in a pit below a rock near the entrance to the Sacred Forest Meadow sells the first Deku Nut Upgrade for forty rupees.

evidence.quote: The first Deku Nut Upgrade is found in the Lost Woods.  Use a bomb to blow up the rock near the entrance to the Sacred Forest Meadow, and in the pit below you'll find a pair of Business Scrubs.  One of them sells the upgrade for forty rupees.

subject: House of Skulltula
text: The Stone of Agony is rewarded by the House of Skulltula for killing twenty Gold Skulltulas, causing the rumble pak to rumble slightly over hidden pits.

evidence.quote: A reward from the House of Skulltula for killing twenty Gold Skulltulas and taking their tokens, the Stone of Agony works in conjunction with the rumble pak to reveal hidden pits.  When you pass over one of these pits, the pak will rumble slightly.
